evidence_plan.requirement: Does their NER model learn NER from both text and images?

payload.reason: The evidence indicates that the NER model incorporates both text and images for named entity recognition, demonstrating a multimodal approach.

claims.text: The NER model learns from both text and images, utilizing a hybrid multimodal approach.
The proposed MNER model significantly outperforms traditional text-only NER models by leveraging visual contexts alongside textual information.
